rules.quote: Check the order of currentBarTime.Store(minTime) vs EvalExitRules calls in the replay loop.
rules.rule: When debugging the EOD FLATTEN bug in daily screener backtest mode, check the order of currentBarTime.Store(minTime) relative to EvalExitRules calls in the replay loop.

rules.quote: verify Jan 20, 2026 is handled correctly by the NYSE calendar
rules.rule: When debugging the EOD FLATTEN bug, verify that Jan 20, 2026 is handled correctly by the NYSE calendar.

rules.quote: Don't rebuild and restart omo-core when changes are only in TOML strategy configs (configs/strategies/*.toml).
rules.rule: Do not rebuild or restart omo-core when the only changes are to TOML strategy config files (configs/strategies/*.toml).

rules.quote: Only rebuild when Go source code changes.
rules.rule: Only rebuild omo-core when Go source code changes.

rules.quote: only rebuild/restart after ENGINE_CHANGEs (Go code modifications).
rules.rule: During strategy tuning, rebuild and restart only after ENGINE_CHANGEs (Go code modifications).

rules.quote: For PARAM_CHANGEs (TOML edits), just run the backtest directly.
rules.rule: For PARAM_CHANGEs (TOML edits), run the backtest directly without rebuilding or restarting.

rules.quote: Always rebuild and restart omo-data via `docker compose`.
rules.rule: Always rebuild and restart omo-data using `docker compose`.

rules.quote: Never run omo-data as a local tmux process.
rules.rule: Never run omo-data as a local tmux process.

rules.quote: Use `docker compose run --rm omo-data --run-once` for manual triggers.
rules.rule: When manually triggering omo-data, use `docker compose run --rm omo-data --run-once`.

rules.quote: Always plan before implementing ENGINE_CHANGEs or strategy rewrites. Present the design for user review before writing code.
rules.rule: Before implementing ENGINE_CHANGEs or strategy rewrites, present the design for user review and do not write code until it is reviewed.

rules.quote: For any significant code change (new strategy logic, engine modifications, multi-file refactors), use EnterPlanMode or present a structured plan and wait for approval before launching go-architect or writing code.
rules.rule: For any significant code change (new strategy logic, engine modifications, multi-file refactors), use EnterPlanMode or present a structured plan, and wait for approval before launching go-architect or writing code.

rules.quote: only tune parameters that directly affect edge
rules.rule: When using the strategy tuning harness, only tune parameters that directly affect edge.

rules.quote: Lock everything else at current defaults.
rules.rule: When using the strategy tuning harness, lock every parameter not designated for tuning at its current default value.

rules.quote: **AVWAP v4.2 — Tune only 6:**
rules.rule: For AVWAP v4.2, tune only these 6 parameters: min_confluence_score, stop_bps, hold_bars, volume_mult, the stagnation minutes in exit_rules, and max_position_bps.

rules.quote: **ORB Break & Retest — Tune only 4:**
rules.rule: For ORB Break & Retest, tune only these 4 parameters: min_rvol, stop_bps, max_retest_bars, and the stagnation minutes in exit_rules.

rules.quote: Lock `orb_window_minutes` at 15
rules.rule: For ORB Break & Retest, lock orb_window_minutes at 15 and do not tune it.

rules.quote: Lock everything else:
rules.rule: Lock at defaults, and do not tune, these parameter groups: entry type toggles, sub-params (such as pullback RSI and pinch bps), structural filters, timing windows, confluence weight toggles, AVWAP stop sub-params, swing stop sub-params, dynamic risk sub-params, VIX filters, options params, and regime overrides.

rules.quote: restrict the DNA search space to only the 11 params listed above
rules.rule: When the strategy-tuner agent runs, restrict the DNA search space to only the 11 parameters listed in the tuning guidance.

rules.quote: Require minimum 500 trades in any backtest before trusting results.
rules.rule: Require a minimum of 500 trades in any backtest before trusting its results.

rules.quote: Use walk-forward validation (tune on 6 months, test on next 2, roll forward).
rules.rule: Validate strategy tuning with walk-forward validation: tune on 6 months, test on the next 2 months, and roll forward.

rules.quote: treat correlated symbols as fewer independent samples
rules.rule: When assessing backtest sample size, treat correlated symbols as fewer independent samples.

rules.quote: verify against live EDGAR before production use
rules.rule: Verify the filer CIKs in sec/filer_config.go against live EDGAR before using them in production.

rules.quote: CLI backfill: `go run ./cmd/omo-backfill-13f --from-quarter 2023Q1 --user-agent "Company email@example.com"`
rules.rule: To backfill 13F filings, run `go run ./cmd/omo-backfill-13f` with `--from-quarter` set to the starting quarter and `--user-agent` set to a company name and contact email.

rules.quote: NOT the main `ridopark` login
rules.rule: Do not set the TWS_USERID secret to the main ridopark login; use the paper account login username staging100.

rules.quote: check `TWS_USERID`/`TWS_PASSWORD` are set in `.env`
rules.rule: When the IB Gateway login screen is stuck, check that TWS_USERID and TWS_PASSWORD are set in .env.

rules.quote: by setting `ACCOUNT=${IBKR_ACCOUNT_ID}` in docker-compose
rules.rule: When the multi-account selector dialog blocks auto-login on IB Gateway staging, set ACCOUNT=${IBKR_ACCOUNT_ID} in docker-compose.

rules.quote: by using the paper-specific login (`staging100`)
rules.rule: When the multi-account selector dialog blocks auto-login on IB Gateway staging, log in with the paper-specific login staging100 instead.
